description: This file defines the interface for a text-based commit graph visualization API used in version control systems, including functions for initializing, updating, and rendering a commit graph.

methods.name: graph_setup_line_prefix
methods.description: Configures the display prefix for lines in the graph, using a diff_options structure.

methods.name: graph_set_column_colors
methods.description: Sets a custom color scheme for the graph columns, enabling colorized output.

methods.name: graph_init
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new git_graph structure based on given revision options.

methods.name: graph_clear
methods.description: Frees resources associated with a git_graph structure.

methods.name: graph_update
methods.description: Updates the graph with a new commit, preparing it to output lines for that commit.

methods.name: graph_is_commit_finished
methods.description: Checks if all lines for the current commit have been output.

methods.name: graph_next_line
methods.description: Outputs the next line of the graph for the current commit into a strbuf.

methods.name: graph_width
methods.description: Returns the current width of the graph in characters.

methods.name: graph_show_commit
methods.description: Prints the entire current commit's graph lines to stdout.

methods.name: graph_show_oneline
methods.description: Prints a single line of the graph to stdout.

methods.name: graph_show_padding
methods.description: Prints vertical padding lines for the graph to stdout.

methods.name: graph_show_remainder
methods.description: Prints the remaining lines of the commit's graph.

methods.name: graph_show_commit_msg
methods.description: Prints the commit message and remaining graph lines to a specified file.
